customManagers.description: Update Makefile tool versions via inline renovate comments
Update version pins in workflow env blocks via inline renovate comments (the github-actions manager only tracks `uses:` refs). Today: MISE_VERSION in ci.yml, the mise binary jdx/mise-action installs.

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before automerging major updates. timestamp-optional: ghcr.io and registry.k8s.io give Renovate no release time, and under the default timestamp-required such a major would stay pending forever (measured 2026-10-16, renovate 44.155.3); it now gets no wait instead.
Group GitHub Actions into one PR
Bump Go version in go.mod to latest patch

This repo's own image, pinned in k8s/golang-web.yaml: its own PR, never automerged. Renovate follows registry tags, not releases (#305 proposed a 0.0.5 tag a week before v0.0.5), so a person merges the pin after checking the tag is a release. An age wait cannot guard it: ghcr.io gives no release time.

Group tool-version bumps (.mise.toml + the remaining Makefile pins) into one PR. minimumReleaseAge 3 days covers the aqua tag-before-publish race: aqua-backed tools get a git tag before their GitHub Release artifacts publish, so `mise install` 404s on a same-day bump. Renovate dates a GitHub tag by the later of its tag time (the commit date for a lightweight tag) and its Release's publish time, so the gap is a lightweight tag on an older commit, looked up before its Release is published. timestamp-optional: a dep with no release time (cloud-provider-kind on registry.k8s.io, govulncheck, read from go.googlesource.com git tags because the module proxy has no entry for its cmd/ path) was held forever under the default timestamp-required (measured 2026-10-16); it now gets no wait.

cloud-provider-kind is tracked by a custom.regex manager with datasource=docker, but the value is a bare version consumed as an image TAG, not a digest-pinnable image reference. config:best-practices' docker:pinDigests would try to append @sha256 and error the branch on every run.

Hold Node on major 24. The Renovate CLI (`make renovate-validate`) requires Node >= 24, and Node 25+ dropped bundled corepack. matchDepNames (not matchPackageNames) is required for the mise manager. Bump this rule and .mise.toml together once the CLI supports a newer major.
jq tags releases `jq-1.8.2`, not `v1.8.2`, so without this Renovate reads no version from them and never proposes a jq update (measured: pinned at 1.8.1, the dry-run proposed nothing).

Group Go toolchain bumps into a single PR: the go.mod directive, the Dockerfile golang base image, and the .mise.toml `go` pin MUST land together or `make check-toolchain-alignment` fails. Must stay LAST so this groupName overrides the per-manager groups above.
